$comment: TEMPLATE -- this file ships with the product and must never contain a
real account alias or email. To register your own Google accounts, run
so your copy is never committed). If you never do that, this program
simply has zero registered Google accounts -- every Google/Duo/Vertex
tool that needs one reports that plainly instead of failing or prompting.
$comment_defaultAccount: The alias used when a tool call does not name one explicitly. Set automatically to your first registered account unless you register more than one and choose a different default.
$comment_cwsLoginAccount: Optional. The alias whose browser session the Chrome Web Store publisher flow is allowed to use. Leave null until you configure Chrome Web Store publishing.
$comment_duoAccount: Optional. The alias for a Duo-protected institutional Google Workspace sign-in (for example, a university NetID). Leave null unless you have that specific setup.
$comment_vertexSeatAccount: Optional. The alias whose Google account holds your paid Vertex AI seat. Only affects which account the dashboard reserves the 'vertex' Gemini lane row for; leave null and that row simply does not appear.
$comment_vertexApiAccount: Optional. The alias whose Google account holds your Vertex AI API-credit pool. Same as vertexSeatAccount but for the 'api' Gemini lane row. These are deliberately two settings because a seat and a credit pool are separate purchases that need not be on the same account.
$comment_accounts: One entry per registered alias, e.g. "personal": { "email": "you@example.com", "label": "Personal Gmail" }. Aliases are letters, digits, dot, underscore, and hyphen only.
